cohort: 66,226 singleton term nulliparous women with vertex presentation
finding: Compared to nulliparous women who attempted vaginal delivery, women who underwent CDMR had similar short-term maternal outcomes with some neonatal benefits.
mod_finding: Compared with nulliparous women who attempted vaginal delivery, women who underwent cesarean delivery on maternal request had similar short-term maternal outcomes with some neonatal benefit.
